rules.summary: A meaningful Image or Icon requires a content description. Null is reserved for content that is deliberately decorative.
rules.title: Describe meaningful images

rules.summary: Interactive output must preserve the design-system touch-target contract and cannot use visual bounds as the only interaction bound.
rules.title: Preserve accessible touch targets

rules.summary: Non-replayable native operations belong in AndroidView.onCommit or another documented commit boundary, not in replayable update work.
rules.title: Keep non-replayable Android View work after commit

rules.summary: Every generated symbol must resolve to the exact owning artifact and version lane; aggregate artifacts are not assumed.
rules.title: Declare the owning artifact

rules.summary: Knowledge, static, compiled, rendered, and compared results are cumulative and cannot be promoted by inference.
rules.title: Report only evidence that actually passed

rules.summary: Use the lifecycle-aware Flow and paired effect APIs for threshold-bound work; do not branch once on a non-observable lifecycle snapshot.
rules.title: Bind resource work to the nearest Lifecycle

rules.summary: Modifier elements are ordered behavior. A conversion or repair must not reorder layout, drawing, input, semantics, or parent-data elements without evidence.
rules.title: Preserve Modifier order

rules.summary: Project analysis cannot execute build logic or write files; migration returns an explicit patch plan before a client applies changes.
rules.title: Keep analysis read-only and bounded

rules.summary: Layout dimensions use UiDp/dp and text sizes use UiSp/sp unless the selected API documents another typed unit.
rules.title: Use typed density and text units

rules.summary: Reject a ViewCompose-looking declaration that is absent from the selected knowledge bundle or is recorded as removed.
rules.title: Use a current published ViewCompose symbol
